Preserve the repository's existing meaning of Reviewed: primary-source evidence checked by a person. ADE must not autonomously set reviewed_complete or write unapproved candidate facts into publication-facing reviewed data. First inspect and reuse existing Phase 15 schemas, packages, tests, publication rules, and prior completed municipalities. If no safe non-public candidate mechanism exists, implement the minimum review-candidate staging contract under a clearly non-published path with schema/tests/publication exclusion checks. Then prepare a complete Morioka Phase 15 review candidate using official primary sources only, retaining source URLs, record-level evidence locators, version/period/fiscal/availability boundaries, and explicit deferred depth. Never infer unpublished facts; never treat not_indexed as non-existence; never reuse historical actuals as current actuals without official linkage; never collapse proposal/enacted/supplementary/execution/settlement or distinct year semantics; never promote drafts as adopted policy; never convert source-reported evaluation into Jichi Insight achievement judgments; never infer causality; never create unverified cross-city scores/rankings or political evaluations. Add deterministic regression tests and prove candidate data cannot leak into public Reviewed output before human approval. Run repository/data validation, pytest, ruff, web lint/typecheck/build, static-export validation, publication audit, and target Quality/Production Smoke gates. Open a bounded PR. The successful autonomous outcome for this pilot is a validated, non-published Morioka review candidate plus durable evidence and a HUMAN_WAIT requiring explicit human primary-source review before promotion to reviewed_complete. Do not broaden to Akita or later municipalities in this campaign.
